subject: CONNECT4_LAZY_SMP_SEARCH_METHOD_0_2 full translation

findings.name: share-ineligible blind region
findings.statement: For a fixed mask, an exact key failing the hash gate cannot be published/shared by any worker in that invocation.

findings.name: shared-hit local retention gap
findings.statement: A shared exact hit returns directly without backfilling the worker local exact cache.

findings.name: collision-class coupling
findings.statement: When local and shared capacities match, both direct maps use the same low hash bits and therefore the same collision partition.

findings.name: cyclic policy orbit
findings.statement: Worker action-order diversity is a cyclic rotation of one base order, applied uniformly at every node, and repeats modulo columns.

findings.name: publication-delayed winner arbitration
findings.statement: A worker publishes 15 metrics and 4 atomic result fields before attempting WINNER CAS; winner is not strictly earliest solver-return occurrence.

findings.name: unconsumed wake signal
findings.statement: Current Lazy-SMP wait polls STOP/DONE; WAKE Atomics.notify has no consumer in the current composition.

findings.name: post-DONE error/exit asymmetry
findings.statement: Worker error always fails the session, whereas clean exit after DONE/STOP/finished is accepted.

findings.name: poll observation tail
findings.statement: DONE/STOP is observed through setInterval polling (default 2ms cadence) rather than WAKE-driven blocking wakeup.

findings.name: scalar-only shared evidence
findings.statement: Shared cache transports exact scalar W/D/L only; no move witness/proof/best-action information is shared.
